summary.text: Kermit Thomas is the Democratic candidate for Illinois House of Representatives District 71 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Daniel Swanson (R).
Thomas is a retired U.S. Army officer who describes himself as a pastor and community advocate.

paragraphs.text: Thomas served in the U.S. Army from 1989 to 2016.

According to Ballotpedia, he graduated from Conroe High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Prairie View A&M University in 1998 and a graduate degree from the Florida Institute of Technology in 2004.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he retired as a Major and is active in his church, the NAACP and local youth initiatives.
Thomas won the March 17, 2026 Democratic primary.

In the survey he said his priorities include improving education, expanding access to health care, supporting veterans and strengthening local economies, and that the district includes both rural and urban communities.
